draft.text:
{"letter":"Dear Hiring Manager,

Concerts one week, hockey nights the next, then a community event after that: the range of what Riverside Arena Group puts on is a big part of why this Event Marketing Specialist role caught my eye. I've spent five years running social media and events for community sports organizations here in Nashville, and I'd love to bring that work to a bigger stage.

Since 2021 I've been the Social Media Manager for Riverbend Youth Soccer League. Over two seasons, I grew our Instagram following from 2,400 to 9,100. I also planned and ran a 40-team spring tournament that drew 600 attendees, which meant owning the event from the first plan to the final whistle. That kind of end-to-end work is what I enjoy most, and it's a lot of what your posting describes.

I pay close attention to what a campaign actually returns. At Riverbend, I cut our paid ad spend by 38% by shifting budget to player-made video, and I use Google Analytics to keep an eye on how our efforts perform. Tracking ticket sales across 60+ events a year would be a step up in scale, and it's a part of the job I'm genuinely looking forward to.

Before Riverbend, I was a Marketing Assistant at Harpeth Valley Rec Center, where I wrote the weekly member newsletter for 3,000 subscribers. Writing every week for the same audience taught me to keep things clear and worth opening. I also coordinated volunteer schedules for 25 community events a year, so juggling a busy calendar of events is familiar ground. Working with promoters and sponsors would be newer territory for me, and I'm eager to learn how Riverside builds those relationships.

I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I could help fill your seats.

Thanks for your time,
Jordan Avery"}
